title: BRCA1 residue-graph and evidence-retrieval benchmark: code and outputs
description: Code and generated outputs for the study "Machine Learning and Graph Neural Networks for BRCA1 Variant Function Prediction: A Leakage-Controlled Evaluation of Evidence Retrieval" (Thakar SB, Ghorpade PN; manuscript in preparation). Includes dataset harmonisation, structure and residue-graph construction, graph and non-graph models, leakage-controlled evidence retrieval, uncertainty, external validation and verification scripts, with out-of-fold predictions and test statistics. Third-party scores that cannot be redistributed (Findlay et al. 2018 function scores, CADD, phyloP, PolyPhen-2, SIFT, Align-GVGD, EVE) are not included and are regenerated from their original sources by the provided scripts.
notes: Code: MIT. Deposited outputs: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see LICENSE-OUTPUTS.md).
